name: Affairs of the Heart
source: Everybody needs a family. Our main character lost his family at a young age, and after years of hardship and pain, he was able to have a life without worrying about money. But the gap in his heart is yet to be fulfilled. With a suggestion from his trans lover, he’s now set his heart to build a “family” of his own.
translation: 每个人都需要一个家庭。我们的主人公年轻时就失去了家人，经过多年的艰辛和痛苦，他能够过上不愁钱的生活。但他内心的缺口还没有被填补。在他的跨性别恋人的建议下，他现在决心建立一个自己的“家庭”。
